groups.description_en: Diagnose primary constraints through funnel, anomaly, and maturity analysis, then route an evidence-backed 30-day plan
groups.description_zh: 通过漏斗、异常与成熟度分析诊断首要约束，并制定有证据支撑的 30 天执行路径

groups.description_en: Plan and synthesize customer research and decision-linked surveys with explicit sampling, evidence, consent, uncertainty, and interpretation boundaries
groups.description_zh: 规划并综合客户研究和决策型调查，明确抽样、证据、同意、不确定性与解释边界

groups.description_en: Research alternatives and size markets with attributable competitive evidence, compatible market units, scenarios, and uncertainty
groups.description_zh: 使用可归因的竞争证据、兼容的市场单元、情景与不确定性研究替代方案并测算市场规模

groups.description_en: Define evidence-backed ICPs, segments, positioning, exclusions, category choices, messages, and validation plans
groups.description_zh: 定义有证据支撑的 ICP、客户分群、定位、排除条件、品类选择、信息与验证计划

groups.name_zh: 产品市场匹配与客户旅程
groups.description_en: Assess product-market fit and customer journeys across problem, first and repeated value, path friction, service dependencies, and evidence boundaries
groups.description_zh: 围绕问题、首次与重复价值、路径摩擦、服务依赖和证据边界评估产品市场匹配与客户旅程

groups.description_en: Design growth models and size opportunities across lifecycle behavior, economics, reach, capacity, overlap, scenarios, and risk
groups.description_zh: 围绕生命周期行为、经济性、触达、承载能力、重叠、情景与风险设计增长模型并测算机会

groups.description_en: Make evidence-bounded growth and market-entry choices across customers, markets, mechanisms, capabilities, sequencing, pilots, and stop rules
groups.description_zh: 围绕客户、市场、机制、能力、排序、试点与停止规则制定证据边界清晰的增长和市场进入策略

groups.description_en: Design and govern go-to-market systems and product launches across audience, offer, motion, readiness, exposure, value, measurement, and scale gates
groups.description_zh: 围绕受众、产品方案、路径、准备度、曝光、价值、测量与扩量门槛设计并治理市场进入和产品发布

groups.description_en: Build content portfolios and permissioned customer proof across questions, claims, formats, channels, workflows, reuse, measurement, and governance
groups.description_zh: 围绕问题、声明、格式、渠道、工作流、复用、测量与治理构建内容组合和已获授权的客户证据

groups.description_en: Write and edit evidence-led copy for pages, campaigns, products, offers, and localization while preserving factual meaning and recording material edits
groups.description_zh: 为页面、营销活动、产品、优惠与本地化创作和编辑证据驱动的文案，同时保留事实含义并记录重要修改

groups.description_en: Design acquisition portfolios and bounded campaigns across audience, offer, channels, journeys, assets, economics, measurement, and operating constraints
groups.description_zh: 围绕受众、产品方案、渠道、旅程、资产、经济性、测量与运营约束设计获客组合和边界明确的营销活动

groups.description_en: Design accountable partnerships and communities around shared customer value, roles, contribution, trust, operations, economics, and product paths
groups.description_zh: 围绕共同客户价值、角色、贡献、信任、运营、经济性与产品路径设计可问责的合作伙伴和社区体系

groups.description_en: Build evidence-led sales enablement and permitted B2B outbound messaging across buying situations, claims, proof, sequences, localization, and stop states
groups.description_zh: 围绕购买情境、声明、证据、沟通序列、本地化与停止状态构建证据驱动的销售赋能和许可型 B2B 外联

groups.description_en: Audit supplied Google, Meta, TikTok, and Douyin advertising evidence without live account access or external changes
groups.description_zh: 在不访问实时账户或执行外部更改的前提下，诊断用户提供的 Google、Meta、TikTok 与抖音广告证据

groups.description_en: Audit and design SEO, programmatic pages, site architecture, structured data, and directory presence with evidence-backed quality and rollout controls
groups.description_zh: 以有证据支撑的质量与发布控制诊断和设计 SEO、程序化页面、站点架构、结构化数据与目录展示

groups.description_en: Define first value and improve activation across onboarding, landing pages, popups, friction, accessibility, measurement, and experiments
groups.description_zh: 定义首次价值，并围绕新手引导、落地页、弹窗、摩擦、无障碍、测量与实验改进激活

groups.description_en: Analyze and improve retention through cohorts, growth accounting, engagement, recurring value, churn, resurrection, and customer health
groups.description_zh: 通过同期群、增长核算、参与度、重复价值、流失、复活与客户健康分析并改进留存

groups.description_en: Design and audit monetization across offers, pricing, packaging, LTV, CAC, unit economics, payback, migration, and customer protection
groups.description_zh: 围绕产品方案、定价、套餐、LTV、CAC、单位经济、回收期、迁移与客户保护设计并诊断变现

groups.description_en: Design and audit referrals, incentives, growth loops, marketplaces, and network effects through participant value, closure, economics, trust, and governance
groups.description_zh: 围绕参与者价值、闭环、经济性、信任与治理设计并诊断推荐、激励、增长循环、多边市场与网络效应

groups.description_en: Design growth metrics, targets, and benchmarks with reproducible contracts, compatible baselines, uncertainty, ownership, and review rules
groups.description_zh: 以可复现契约、兼容基线、不确定性、归属与复盘规则设计增长指标、目标和基准

groups.description_en: Design tracking plans and audit data quality across events, identity, consent, lineage, reconciliation, monitoring, releases, and deprecation
groups.description_zh: 围绕事件、身份、同意、血缘、对账、监控、发布与退场设计追踪方案并诊断数据质量

groups.description_en: Audit attribution and marketing mix models across journeys, media, identity, outcomes, reconciliation, incrementality, calibration, and uncertainty
groups.description_zh: 围绕旅程、媒体、身份、结果、对账、增量性、校准与不确定性诊断归因和营销组合模型

groups.description_en: Build integrated growth plans across strategy, capacity, investments, budgets, initiatives, dependencies, scenarios, approvals, and review cadence
groups.description_zh: 围绕策略、承载能力、投资、预算、项目、依赖、情景、审批与复盘节奏构建一体化增长计划

groups.description_en: Run growth reviews and govern decisions and risks through reconciled evidence, alternatives, authority, commitments, monitoring, and escalation
groups.description_zh: 通过已对账证据、备选方案、权限、承诺、监控与升级机制运营增长复盘并治理决策和风险

groups.description_en: Build growth learning, postmortems, and change systems with source lineage, causal boundaries, adoption, correction, follow-through, and retirement
groups.description_zh: 以来源谱系、因果边界、采用、纠正、后续行动与退场机制构建增长学习、复盘和变更体系

groups.name_zh: 增长基础设施与收入运营
groups.description_en: Assess growth infrastructure and RevOps across data, metrics, experiments, revenue entities, systems, handoffs, governance, and remediation
groups.description_zh: 围绕数据、指标、实验、收入实体、系统、交接、治理与修复诊断增长基础设施和收入运营
